news.title: New Zealand select squad for first FIFA U-15 Boys World Cup in Azerbaijan
news.lede: New Zealand Football have named their squad for the inaugural FIFA U-15 World Cup & Festival, starting in Azerbaijan this month. The squad includes six players from Wellington Phoenix, three from Auckland United, two from Christchurch United and one each from Nomads United, Bay Olympic and Fencibles United. Unlike traditional FIFA age-group tournaments, the competition will use an eight-a-side format, with matches comprising two 20-minute halves. The team will be coached by Wellington Phoenix’s head of boys’ talent development and men’s U-18 head coach, Cam Grieve.

news.title: Fifa to offer members US$6.35bil development fund windfall
news.lede: The plan is due for approval at a Fifa Council meeting in Zurich, attended by president Gianni Infantino and the football body's 36 other members. (EPA Images pic) PARIS: Football's world governing body Fifa is planning to set up a US$6.35-billion development fund for the next four years, AFP learned Wednesday from a source close to the matter. The plan is due to be approved at its Council meeting on Thursday in Zurich, where Fifa president Gianni Infantino and the 36 other members of the federation's executive will gather. To finance this development fund for the 2026–2030 period, which would allow money to be distributed to Fifa's 211 federations as well as to the regional confederations, it would draw in part on its financial reserves after a commercially successful 2026 World Cup.

news.title: Morocco Women to Face France in Friendly Ahead of 2027 World Cup
news.lede: Rabat - Morocco's women's national team is set to face France in an away friendly scheduled for Saturday, December 5. The game takes place at the Auguste Bonal Stadium in Sochaux, kicking off at 9:10 PM GMT. Both squads will use this encounter to test squad depth and refine their game plans ahead of major upcoming competitions, most notably the 2027 FIFA Women's World Cup in Brazil. For both sides, the fixture offers a valuable opportunity to evaluate player readiness and fine-tune strategy ahead of official tournament play.

news.title: Flamingos settle in Rabat ahead of U-17 World Cup opener
news.lede: Coach Akeem Busari’s side completed their final training session in Casablanca on Monday evening before travelling to the Moroccan capital on Tuesday. The players subsequently participated in a light training session as preparations intensified for their opening Group B encounter. The Nigerian contingent is accommodated at the Complexe Sportif Feminin. The Flamingos will face Poland at the Mohammed VI Football Complex, Pitch 4, on Saturday, with kick-off scheduled for 8pm.

news.title: ParaMatildas hunt more Australian football history at World Cup
news.lede: Eloise Northam will be representing the ParaMatildas at her third IFCPF Women's World Cup. (ABC News: Daniel Irvine). The ParaMatildas are looking to defend their IFCPF World Cup title in Atlanta after winning the 2024 tournament. The Pararoos are also searching for a breakthrough top-10 finish in the men's competition.
